description: futures-util 0.3 has an optional dependency futures_01 = { package = "futures", version = "0.1" }. gen-rust-buck resolves it to the vendored crate named futures regardless of version, so once futures 0.3 is vendored (it depends on futures-util) the rustdeps cell has a configured target cycle futures-util@0.3.34 -> futures -> futures-util, even though the compat feature that enables futures_01 is off. Seen in turnkey-vnm.2; avoided there by depending on futures-util instead of futures. Fix: match a dependency to a vendored crate by version requirement, and drop optional deps whose enabling feature isn't on.
title: gen-rust-buck resolves renamed optional deps by name, ignoring the version
